# Compound interest

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/compound/

Explore how an initial balance and regular month-end contributions can grow at a constant annual rate. Choose a compounding frequency.

## How to use it

1. Enter the numbers, dates or units you want to compare.
2. Choose the calculation options and calculate.
3. Review the result together with the assumptions shown.

## Example

Start with NPR 100000 and add NPR 5000 each month to explore a ten-year savings scenario.

## Limits and checks

This is a mathematical projection, not a promised return. Taxes, fees and inflation are not included.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
